For we have heard how Yahweh dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did…

He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Red_Sea
people.line: Sea crossed by Israelites in the Exodus

translations.web: By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
translations.bsb: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were drowned.
translations.kjv: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
translations.asv: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were swallowed up.
